system.description: Something in you became wholly monstrous at the Embrace, your outward form twisting to reflect your inner Beast. While your true form is apparent you cannot initiate Social Challenges except those involving intimidation, and you may not take Appearance-related Traits such as Alluring or Gorgeous. Nosferatu and Samedi may not take this Flaw.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
